def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])

    rows8=[i for i in range(h) if any(v==8 for v in g[i])]

for i,pr in enumerate(pairs):
    inp,oup=pr['input'],pr['output']
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    print('PAIR',i+1,f'{h}x{w}')
    # marker
    mk=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]==2]
    print(' marker',mk)
    # full walls (rows/cols entirely 8)
    wr=[r for r in range(h) if all(inp[r][c]==8 for c in range(w))]
    wc=[c for c in range(w) if all(inp[r][c]==8 for r in range(h))]
    print(' solid rows',wr,'solid cols',wc)
    # near-full walls
    wr2=[r for r in range(h) if sum(inp[r][c]==8 for c in range(w))>=w-3]
    wc2=[c for c in range(w) if sum(inp[r][c]==8 for r in range(h))>=h-3]
    print(' near-full rows',wr2,'cols',wc2)
    for r in wr2: print('  row',r,'gaps',[c for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=8])
    for c in wc2: print('  col',c,'gaps',[r for r in range(h) if inp[r][c]!=8])
    # 2-runs in output: horizontal runs
    def runs(cells):
        out=[]
        for k,vs in cells.items():
            vs=sorted(vs); s=e=vs[0]
            for v in vs[1:]:
                if v==e+1: e=v
                else: out.append((k,s,e)); s=e=v
            out.append((k,s,e))
        return out
    hr={}
    vr={}
    for r in range(h):
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if oup[r][c]==2 and inp[r][c]!=8 or oup[r][c]==2]
        if cs: hr[r]=cs
    for c in range(w):
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if oup[r][c]==2]
        if rs: vr[c]=rs
    print(' h-runs:',runs(hr))
    print(' v-runs:',runs(vr))
    print()

def T(g): return [list(r) for r in zip(*g)]
def mirror(g): return [list(reversed(r)) for r in g]

def normalize(g,out):
    mk,rw,cw=norm(g)
    if cw:  # vertical walls -> transpose
        g,o=T(g),T(out); mk,rw,cw=norm(g)
    # marker should be on left or top edge; if right edge, mirror
    if mk[1]==len(g[0])-1:
        g,o=mirror(g),mirror(o); mk,rw,cw=norm(g)
    return g,o,mk,rw,cw

    rowwall=[r for r in range(h) if sum(1 for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==8)>w*0.6]
    colwall=[c for c in range(w) if sum(1 for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==8)>h*0.6]
    if colwall and not rowwall:
        T=True; g=[list(r) for r in zip(*g)]; h,w=w,h; mk=(mk[1],mk[0])
        rowwall=sorted(colwall)
    if mk[0]==h-1:  # marker on bottom -> mirror rows
        M=True; g=g[::-1]; mk=(h-1-mk[0],mk[1]); rowwall=sorted(h-1-r for r in rowwall)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    walls=[]
    for r in rowwall:
        gaps=[c for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=8]
        walls.append((r,gaps))
    inc=[mk[1]]  # incoming points (columns)
    spans=[]
    used_list=[]
    for i,(r,gaps) in enumerate(walls):
        lo,hi=min(inc),max(inc)
        within=[x for x in gaps if lo<=x<=hi]
        left=[x for x in gaps if x<lo]; right=[x for x in gaps if x>hi]
        if left and right: used=gaps[:]
        elif within: used=within[:]
        elif left or right:
            # nearest to span
            best=min(min(abs(x-lo),abs(x-hi)) for x in gaps)
            used=[x for x in gaps if min(abs(x-lo),abs(x-hi))==best]
        else: used=gaps[:]
        used_list.append(used)
        if len(used)>=2: spans.append((min(used),max(used)))
        else:
            gp=used[0]
            sides=set()
            if any(p<gp for p in inc): sides.add('L')
            if any(p>gp for p in inc): sides.add('R')
            if not sides: sides={'L','R'}
            a=0 if 'L' in sides else gp
            b=w-1 if 'R' in sides else gp
            spans.append((a,b))
        inc=used[:]  # incoming for next wall = used gap columns
    # connectivity repair: add nearest unused gap to a wall if its trunk dangles
    # (skip; check below)
    for i,(r,gaps) in enumerate(walls):
        a,b=spans[i]
        for c in range(a,b+1): out[r-1][c]=2
        nxt = spans[i+1] if i+1<len(walls) else None
        for gp in used_list[i]:
            if not (a<=gp<=b): continue
            if nxt is not None and not (nxt[0]<=gp<=nxt[1]): continue
            out[r][gp]=2
            for rr in range(r+1, (walls[i+1][0] if nxt else h)):
                out[rr][gp]=2
    if M: out=out[::-1]
    if T: out=[list(r) for r in zip(*out)]
    return out
